verdict.rationale: Justworks is an HR/payroll/PEO platform that stores sensitive employee data, so controlling data retention and deletion is a fair axis for it. The evidence pack covers payroll, benefits, time off, onboarding and Xero integration, but says nothing about retention settings, data deletion, or privacy controls. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
